connector.name: Seerxo
connector.registryDescription: Generate SEO-optimized Etsy listings - title, description, and 13 tags - from your AI assistant.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.seerxo.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package seerxo. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the semihbugrasezer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SEERXO_EMAIL
env.description: Optional Seerxo account email; omit when credentials were saved with 'seerxo login'.

env.name: SEERXO_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key from seerxo.com — omit to use the free tier set up via 'seerxo configure'.
